visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Width does not change
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The progress bar should grow to 80 percent when the button is pressed, but it does not change. The number is set without a unit.

solution.explanation: The style property needs a CSS value with a unit, such as '80%' or '80px'. A plain number is not valid there, so the browser ignores it.

checks.label: After a click the fill takes up most of the line
